gaps.explanation: 'Her confidence' — the noun; 'confident' is the adjective.

gaps.sentence: She's a leading ___ (SCIENCE) in climate research.
The new software ___ (ABLE) staff to work securely from anywhere.
gaps.explanation: 'Enable somebody to do something' — the present-tense verb fits the singular subject.
People are satisfied; things are satisfying or satisfactory.

gaps.sentence: With careful ___ (PREPARE), the trek is perfectly safe.
The factory has doubled its ___ (PRODUCE) of electric batteries.
gaps.explanation: 'Its production' — the noun for the amount manufactured follows the possessive.

gaps.sentence: They searched the area ___ (SYSTEM) for clues.
The project was abandoned for ___ (FINANCE) reasons.
gaps.explanation: An adjective is needed before 'reasons': financial.
